::: lead
Applied mathematician turned data scientist. I build machine learning and LLM systems for scientific and business problems, and I teach other people to build them carefully.
:::

## Experience

::: cv-entry
::: cv-head
### Teaching Assistant Professor of Data Science
[Jul 2025 – Present]{.cv-date}
:::
::: cv-org
Department of Data Science, University of Arkansas · Fayetteville, AR
:::
- Lead industry partnerships with Arvest Bank, Walmart, J.B. Hunt, Tyson, and Mastercard. These turn into guest lectures, datasets, and practicum projects, and help students land internships and jobs.
- Designed and teach courses on generative and agentic AI. Students build RAG systems, orchestration pipelines, and agentic workflows, and learn local LLM deployment with Ollama, pipelines with LangChain, and monitoring with LangSmith.
- Rebuilt our Statistical Learning course around modern modeling with tidymodels, data cleaning, and deployment with Docker and MLflow.
- Teach about 80 incoming freshmen the data science process, its tools, and its ethics.
:::

::: cv-entry
::: cv-head
### Postdoctoral Fellow, Data Science and Computational Biology
[Aug 2024 – Jun 2025]{.cv-date}
:::
::: cv-org
University of Arkansas System Division of Agriculture · Little Rock, AR
:::
- Developed generative models, including variational autoencoders and self-attentive transformers, for genomic health data.
- Worked with Cobb Genetics on an interpretable classification workflow for *Enterococcus cecorum* lineages, with careful safeguards against data leakage. Published in *Frontiers in Microbiology* (2026).
- Designed pipelines to model tissue-damage recovery patterns in high-dimensional biological data.
- Built reproducible workflows with Nextflow, Bactopia, Docker, and IslandViewer.
:::

::: cv-entry
::: cv-head

:::
::: cv-org
Sam M. Walton College of Business, University of Arkansas · Fayetteville, AR
:::
- Taught Python, R, Git, Bash, and optimization methods to 100+ students.
- Mentored advanced projects in routing, network flow, and facility location using CVXPY, Pyomo, PySAL, and Gurobi.

::: cv-entry
::: cv-head
### Health Data Science Intern
[May 2023 – Aug 2023]{.cv-date}
:::
::: cv-org
Arkansas Blue Cross and Blue Shield · Springdale, AR
:::
- Used difference-in-differences and Granger causality to estimate how insurance policy affected maternal-health outcomes in observational claims data.
- Built regression and Markov models combining claims with built-environment, social determinants of health, socioeconomic, Census, and LexisNexis data for maternal risk assessment and pregnancy-stage prediction.
- Built an LSTM forecasting model for claims volume in TensorFlow and tidyverts that improved forecast accuracy by 25%.
- Made R Shiny dashboards so stakeholders could actually use the results.
:::
